name: International relations
solves: explain why costly conflict happens between parties who could bargain

tools.name: Bargaining model of war (Fearon)
tools.does: shows a bargain exists unless specific obstacles block it
hypotheses: rational unitary actors
war is costly
the obstacles are private information, commitment problems or indivisible stakes

tools.name: Deterrence theory
tools.does: says a threat prevents action when it is credible and costly enough
hypotheses: the opponent weighs costs and benefits
the threat is communicated and believed
